notes: Structural bounds only. No wall-clock latency or RSS threshold belongs here until the B0 distributions are pinned (plan, todo 17).
Raising a bound is a deliberate commit, the scripts/ci/check_code_size.py ratchet in the same shape. A regression cannot raise its own ceiling.
Each bound is enforced by scripts/perf/check_structural.py against the STRUCTURAL_PERF lines the repo's own tests print.
context condensation: one generic budget (48 KiB), a one-line notice for an unchanged re-read, and exactly one aging batch per pressure crossing.
irc mailbox: a 100-message cap that drops the oldest, one body allocation per broadcast, no waiter left parked after timeout/cancel churn, and a 16-leg broadcast concurrency ceiling.

skill loading: listing the catalog reads at most one frontmatter prefix per skill (8 KiB each, so a 32 KiB body read whole fails), and a request against an unchanged workspace reads no SKILL.md and lists no skill directory.
mcp config: once warmed, a session start against unchanged user-level MCP config files (horon-agent, Claude, Codex) reads none of them again.
hooks: the request projection with no pre_request hook configured spawns no child process and copies no message; the probe floor (request_messages_in_probe) fails a run that measured nothing.

prefix: the tool catalog one core-profile request sends is 9151 bytes for the core profile's eight eager tools (was 9751; 9714 measured before the description cuts; raised from 9111 by the 40-byte rg note bash_definition_prefers_repository_search_tools requires), measured from the request body the provider builds; the tool count is checked beside it so a catalog that shrank its way under the ceiling fails instead of passing.

prompt: the core static prompt with no prompt files is at most 1322 bytes (ci.yml run 43656656999, down from 1367), a request after the session captured its prompt sources reads none of them (54 probes over nine requests before the snapshot, 0 after), and at most one listed-tool index row is cut mid-sentence (todo keeps its text; 5 rows were cut before).

session context: describing a directory outside any repository starts no git process (1 before), a work tree starts one (3 before), and a machine whose PCI list has no display controller starts no GPU probe (1 before); structural-perf run 43654214186.

tool dispatch: one Registry::execute call of a fixture tool, counted by the allocator of the tool_dispatch_perf target, for a small file-write input and for one carrying 10 KB of content. The four ceilings are the measured values: 632 allocations and 28926 requested bytes per dispatch for the small input, 632 and 39313 for the 10 KB one, read from structural-perf run 43775715090 after a prepared schema was found without building its text. Earlier values: 638 and 29430, 638 and 39817 once the lifecycle fields were built once per dispatch (run 43774864729); 682 and 32002, 696 and 107420 before any change (runs 43770373891 and 43772274944).
